Material RPT with AMJ Land Holdings Ltd: Accepting ICDs, granting/availing loans, providing/obtaining security and corporate guarantees for 5 years (FY2026-27 to FY2030-31) up to ₹1,000 Lakhs outstanding at any time, interest 9-12% p.a., unsecured, repayable on demand, for working capital; proposed transaction value ₹1,000 Lakhs (214.02% of 3P Land's consolidated turnover, 19.04% of AMJ Land's turnover).

Material RPT with AMJ Land Holdings Ltd: Sharing common services (telephone, electricity, computer, HR, reimbursement, sale/purchase of goods/services, administrative support) on continuous basis, omnibus approval sought, not exceeding ₹50 Lakhs per FY plus taxes (10.70% of 3P Land's turnover, 19.04% of AMJ Land's turnover); cost allocation on actual usage basis without profit element.

The Company's revenue by way of earnings from interest and dividend constitutes nearly 60% of its total revenue which is essential for the Company to continue to maintain its classification as Core Investment Company under the Core Investment Companies (Reserve Bank) Directions 2016.
The profit after tax is about 46% of its total income.
Segment-wise financial performance is given in the Company's consolidated Accounts.

The existing controls of the Company are commensurate with the nature of the business and are always subjected to periodical review by Auditors and Audit Committee and are considered appropriate and adequate to the size of its operation.
Operating profit margin increased to 62.30% from 61.58% due to increase in rental income and interest income.
Net Profit Margin slightly decreased to 46.62% from 46.73% due to increase in tax.
Return on Net Worth slightly decreased to 4.87% from 4.92% due to increase in tax.
Current Ratio decreased to 7.16 from 10.50 mainly due to increase in employee benefit obligation.

outlook.statement: The Company's land of about 16 acres at Village Khairy, Tehsil Kareli, Narsinghpur, Madhya Pradesh which is lying vacant, is within the vicinity of rapidly growing urbanization. This land is awaiting finalization of the Narsinghpur Development Plan after which it is proposed to be developed.

risks: The Government's contention has been that the land at Pune continues to be subject to applicability of repealed Urban Land Ceiling Act 1976 which matter is pending before the Government authorities pursuant to the directions of Hon'ble High Court of Bombay.
